description: This Java class serves as a factory for creating and parsing instances related to 'metadata' headers within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides static methods to obtain header objects, parse JSON representations, and generate new metadata headers, facilitating decoupling of implementations from interfaces.

classes.name: MetadataPackageFactory
classes.description: A final class providing static factory methods for creating and parsing metadata header objects, designed to hide implementation details and enforce immutability.

methods.name: getMetadataHeader
methods.description: Creates a DefaultMetadataHeader instance from a key and value.

methods.name: metadataHeaderFromJson
methods.description: Parses a JsonObject to produce a MetadataHeader instance.

methods.name: parseMetadataHeaderKey
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence to produce a DefaultMetadataHeaderKey.

methods.name: getMetadataHeaderKey
methods.description: Creates a DefaultMetadataHeaderKey from a JsonPointer.

methods.name: parseMetadataHeaders
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence to produce MetadataHeaders.

methods.name: newMetadataHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new, empty instance of MetadataHeaders.
